description.value: Noodlebox is a Canadian fast-casual chain serving customizable Asian-inspired wok-fired noodle and rice dishes, including Pad Thai, Kung Pao, Butter Chicken, and Spicy Peanut Noodle boxes. Located in a strip mall on McDonald Park Road in Sidney, it offers a broad menu with vegan and gluten-friendly modifications available on request. It's a practical calorie-refueling stop for cyclists riding the Saanich Peninsula.
